goals.easy:
Goal: Observe the visible entity-value associations, remember them, decode the physical expression, and enter its exact result using only the closed gripper fingertips on the nine keys.

TASK RECIPE:
Three entities, two operations, no parentheses; a two-digit result.

Memorize the visible entity-value associations and compute the physical expression. Enter the decimal result on the keys 1 through 9 using only closed gripper fingertips; do not use a held object. A digit is registered only after a complete valid press-and-release cycle. Repeated digits require separate cycles. The episode ends only after the final digit has been released and all keys satisfy the release condition.

Scoring (highest eligible stage; stages are not added):
0: Any other outcome.
100: The exact digit sequence is entered through valid fingertip press-and-release cycles, all keys are released, and the episode completes normally.
